purpose: Teach: 北九州/日光/アフガン/モロッコ/ナポレオン/富士通/早稲田大学/京都大学

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、北九州市出身でいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, that customer Aoi had was from Kitakyushu, right?
lines.style: Soft, half-formed thought. Speaking to herself as much as to Aoi. Wondering aloud, noticing the detail. Warm curiosity, no urgency.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、日光東照宮の写真を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, and they showed Aoi photos from Nikko Toshogu. Really beautiful ones.
lines.style: Agreeing gently, adding her own observation. Speaking as if continuing a quiet shared thought. Appreciative, almost wistful about the beauty being described.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アフガン難民支援の活動家だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's an activist, actually — works with Afghan refugee support.
lines.style: New information offered with quiet respect. Slight lift on the revelation, then settling back down. Noticing depth in someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、モロッコ旅行のお話して下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned a trip to Morocco too, didn't they? Told Aoi all about it.
lines.style: Recalling a detail with soft pleasure. Voice follows the wandering path of the story being remembered. No hurry. Presence of good listening.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ナポレオンの伝記を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And I think they were reading a biography of Napoleon.
lines.style: Uncertain but fondly remembering. Gentle questioning in the voice—checking her own memory. The tone of someone piecing together an impression of another person.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、富士通のシステムを使ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, they use Fujitsu systems for their work, if I remember right.
lines.style: Technical detail offered without emphasis. Quiet, almost parenthetical. The voice of someone noticing without needing to announce the noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、早稲田大学のOBだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were a Waseda graduate, I think.
lines.style: Tentatively building a picture. Soft voice, thinking while speaking. The confidence of casual memory, not certainty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、京都大学の研究者でいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, they're a researcher at Kyoto University—that's what they said.
lines.style: Gentle correction, settling on what she's certain of. Voice lands softly on the fact. Closing a thought with quiet clarity, trailing into reflection.
